name: Skills Lab lists the seeded skills, previews one, and shows the Test Quality Reviewer's attached skills
description: Read-only. Loads /skills, opens the seeded branch-coverage skill (its card's name button, aria-label 'Open branch-coverage'), lands on the Preview tab and sees the block exactly as the agent receives it ('When to apply:' line). Then opens the seeded Test Quality Reviewer from /agents, switches to its Skills tab and sees its three seeded skills enabled out of the seven in the library. Sorts before 09, the one flow that writes.
